mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an engineer-designed retrofit and a prescriptive retrofit?

acceptedAnswer.text: An engineer-designed retrofit involves a licensed structural engineer creating custom plans for your home, which is often necessary for complex or non-standard structures. A prescriptive retrofit follows pre-approved, standardized guidelines, suitable for simpler, typical wood-frame homes built before 1979. The choice depends on your home's unique characteristics and local building department requirements; for example, many older homes in areas like Piedmont may benefit from an engineered approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engineer-designed retrofits use custom plans for complex homes, while prescriptive retrofits follow standard guidelines for simpler structures. The best approach depends on your home.
